name: chalet
description: Short-term rental (Airbnb, Vrbo) market data, property income estimates, and intros to vetted STR agents, from Chalet.

interface.longDescription: Chalet answers short-term rental investing questions with Chalet data: typical revenue, nightly rates, occupancy and seasonality for US markets; income and cash-flow estimates for a specific property based on nearby comparable rentals; and intros to vetted local short-term rental agents. Estimates are based on Chalet data and are not a guarantee of income.
defaultPrompt: How much do Airbnbs make in Gatlinburg, TN?
Would a 3 bed, 2 bath house in Scottsdale at $650k cash flow as an Airbnb?
Connect me with a short-term rental agent in Destin, FL.
